title.en: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Restricted-Access Claude Mythos 5.1
title.zhHans: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 与受限访问的 Claude Mythos 5.1

searchSummary.en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 on September 1, 2026 with 75% cheaper cache reads, while Claude Mythos 5.1 remained restricted to vetted cyberdefense and life-sciences access programs.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日发布 Claude Fable 5.1，并将缓存读取价格下调 75%；Claude Mythos 5.1 则仍限于通过审核的网络防御与生命科学访问计划。

summary.en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 on September 1, 2026. Fable 5.1 is available through Anthropic's API and named cloud platforms; Anthropic says Mythos 5.1 is available to a set of vetted U.S. organizations, with broader access programs expanding in phases. Anthropic reduced cache-read pricing to $0.25 per million tokens and announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which are also rolling out in phases.
summary.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日宣布 Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5.1。Fable 5.1 可通过 Anthropic API 及指定云平台使用；Anthropic 称 Mythos 5.1 已向一批经审核的美国组织开放，较广泛的访问计划将分阶段扩展。Anthropic 将缓存读取价格降至每百万 token 0.25 美元，并宣布 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，该机制同样在分阶段推出。

narrative.en: Anthropic says Fable and Mythos share underlying weights but use different safeguard configurations. Its launch materials report benchmark and scientific-task results, and VentureBeat independently describes those benchmark figures as vendor-reported rather than proof of superiority. The event records the release, the cache-read price change, and the restricted-access structure; it does not treat claimed scientific or security performance as independently replicated.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 称 Fable 与 Mythos 共享底层权重，但采用不同的安全护栏配置。其发布材料报告了基准与科学任务结果，VentureBeat 则独立指出这些基准数字属于厂商报告，而非优越性的证明。该事件记录发布、缓存读取价格变化及受限访问结构，不将所称的科研或安全性能视为已被独立复现。

description.en: Introduces a new broadly available model configuration and a more restricted configuration for selected high-risk professional uses.
description.zhHans: 引入一款广泛可用的新模型配置，以及面向部分高风险专业用途的更受限配置。

description.en: Anthropic's 75% cache-read price reduction may lower costs for workloads that reuse long context, subject to usage mix and phased product availability.
description.zhHans: Anthropic 将缓存读取价格下调 75%，对复用长上下文的工作负载可能降低成本，但取决于使用结构与分阶段产品可用性。

text.en: Anthropic announced Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 on September 1, 2026 and reduced Fable cache-read pricing by 75% to $0.25 per million tokens.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日宣布 Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1，并将 Fable 缓存读取价格下调 75% 至每百万 token 0.25 美元。

text.en: Anthropic reported benchmark and scientific-task results for the models; independent coverage characterizes those performance figures as vendor-reported.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 报告了两款模型的基准与科学任务结果；独立报道将这些性能数字定性为厂商报告。

text.en: Mythos 5.1 remains restricted to vetted organizations and access programs are expanding in phases; EFS support is also rolling out rather than universally available at launch.
text.zhHans: Mythos 5.1 仍限于经审核组织，访问计划正分阶段扩展；EFS 支持也是逐步推出，并非发布时普遍可用。

editorial.reviewNotes: Replaced inaccessible system-card and Hindu citations with retained VentureBeat coverage; Mythos and EFS availability are explicitly phased/restricted.
